name: shell_heredoc_parse_heredoc_operator
notes: Heredoc-operator parser: (end, delimiter, strip_tabs, quoted) vs None. Harness textually includes src/tools/shell_heredoc.c so the REAL static C port is exercised; twin imports LIVE tools/shell_heredoc.py. Inputs encoded '<index>\t<command>' with index pointing at '<<'. Covers: bare/quoted/tab-strip delimiters, <<< rejection, empty delimiter at EOL, ';' terminator break, double-quote backslash escapes, backslash-newline failure, unterminated quote. 14 inputs.
